programs.title: Tom Kerridge's Pub Kitchen Secrets
programs.desc: Tom shares his love for the heat of the pub kitchen. Rotisserie beetroot, blowtorched mackerel and a flambéed brandy sauce are all on the menu.

programs.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programs.desc: Who can resist a sweet treat, especially when it's an authentic Italian. From biscotti to an espresso swirl cake, Silvia's twist on classic recipes are sure to make your mouth water.

programs.title: Food Safari
programs.desc: Food Safari discovers some of the vast range of flavours and dishes across the expanse of the United States of America - from the southern states to California.

programs.title: Haigh's Chocolates - From Bean To Bar
programs.desc: A century-old family business evolves from a humble Adelaide confectioner into Australia's finest chocolate maker.

programs.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programs.desc: Justine gets busy in the kitchen with a white chocolate mousse with Pedro Ximenez Prunes and some delicious kataifi prawns, and then Sydney based chef, Massimo Mele joins Justine.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: It's a night of sensational seafood as Adam and his world-class guests, swimmer Ariarne Titmus and chef Alejandro Saravia, share how they reel in a crowd.
